Gjoa v0.5.0 moves the browser base from Firefox 153.0.3 to Firefox 160.0.

## Changes

- Updated the engine to Firefox 160.0.
- Rebased the native blocking patch onto Firefox's new in-tree content-classifier engine.
- Rebased the dark-mode engine patches onto Firefox 160's layout and style changes.

## Downloads

- Linux x86_64: tar.xz or AppImage
- Linux ARM64: tar.xz or AppImage
- macOS ARM64: DMG
- Windows x86_64: ZIP
